critique: The render is already strong: the ISO reads instantly as an FPGA accelerator card (interleaved BRAM banks on the -X edge, open butterfly array with exposed copper multipliers and add/sub blocks, exploded radix-4 unit and exploded heatsink lifted clear so nothing important is swallowed), and the elevation views show every bus grounded by a standoff with no floating members. The honest ceiling this pass is buildability, not geometry: the headline conflict-free bank/offset functions, the per-stage crossbar permutation sigma_s, the twiddle-ROM rearranged-loop addressing, and the FSM table are all [source-missing] in the paper body and remain reproduction-invented [conv] — those cannot be closed by editing geometry without fabricating paper values, so they must route to the evidence/amend loop, not here. The one defect I could close in the scene is a real self-consistency bug: the committed bank function was written two contradictory ways (`(i>>9)&7` in crossbar/addr_gen/bram params vs `(i>>9)&1` in addr_gen ops); for N=1024 only bit 9 exists above the offset field, so `&1` is the correct and only honest form.
